item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong evidence on macro outcomes, but much of it is indirect: good inflation/unemployment/GDP data do not prove Biden personally caused the results. The cleanest negative evidence is on honesty and process, not on core economic policy: the inflation misstatement, campaign-targeted framing on student debt, tariff politics, and the post-debate management collapse. Evidence on sanctions/commodity management is thinner than evidence on inflation and labor markets, but the Russia oil-price-cap sanctions package is a solid positive datapoint.
